# power-user-scripts

<p class="tagline">A toolkit of terminal aliases, AI-powered commit scripts, and Windows power-user utilities.</p>

<div class="cta">
  <a href="python/" class="primary">Browse the toolbox</a>
  <a href="https://github.com/dhruvinrsoni/power-user-scripts" class="secondary">View on GitHub</a>
</div>

<pre>$ python aic.py -a    →  auto-staged + committed with an AI-written message</pre>

</section>

<div class="grid cards" markdown>

-   :material-language-python: __Python AI commits__

    ---

    Five LLM providers, one wrapper. Auto-detects the cheapest available
    provider and generates conventional commit messages.

    [:octicons-arrow-right-24: Open](python.md)

-   :material-source-branch: __Git-Sutras__

    ---

    A grammar of Git aliases inspired by Pāṇini. Born from a 3 AM merge
    conflict that exposed how Git really thinks.

    [:octicons-arrow-right-24: Open](git-sutras.md)

-   :material-github: __GH-Sutras__

    ---

    The GitHub CLI extension of the Sutra philosophy. Stop alt-tabbing
    between terminal and browser.

    [:octicons-arrow-right-24: Open](gh-sutras.md)

-   :material-git: __Custom Git wrapper__

    ---

    A drop-in `git.cmd` that injects branch and ahead/behind status
    straight into your prompt.

    [:octicons-arrow-right-24: Open](custom-git.md)

-   :material-console: __CMD utilities__

    ---

    Fifteen-plus root-level `.cmd` shortcuts for git config, API
    monitoring, terminal aliases, and admin tasks.

    [:octicons-arrow-right-24: Open](cmd-utilities.md)

-   :material-powershell: __PowerShell profiles__

    ---

    A profile setup with `posh-git`, custom prompt colors, fonts, and
    persistent function libraries.

    [:octicons-arrow-right-24: Open](powershell.md)

-   :material-bash: __Shell scripts__

    ---

    A WSL bootstrap script and a hybrid shell/batch template for
    cross-platform utilities.

    [:octicons-arrow-right-24: Open](shell-scripts.md)

-   :material-text-box-outline: __Prompt templates__

    ---

    Six AI prompts for commit messages, PR descriptions, search,
    rephrasing, and creative writing.

    [:octicons-arrow-right-24: Open](prompts.md)

-   :material-cursor-default-click: __Cursor rules__

    ---

    Atomic-commit guidelines for the Cursor editor agent. Keeps AI-led
    commits sane.

    [:octicons-arrow-right-24: Open](cursor-rules.md)

-   :material-tools: __Hacks & tweaks__

    ---

    Registry tweaks, Group Policy notes, an Excel VBA logger, and a
    bookmark to ANSICON.

    [:octicons-arrow-right-24: Open](hacks.md)

</div>
